title: VAD: Vectorized Scene Representation for Efficient Autonomous Driving
grouping: A large light-grey rounded panel holds the inference pipeline; a second grey rounded panel at the far right, titled in bold 'Vectorized Planning Constraints', holds three constraint boxes. Four phase labels with thin bracket lines run along the bottom (Backbone, Vectorized Scene Learning, Planning Inferring Phase, Planning Training Phase). The BEV feature grid in the centre branches up to a motion module and down to a map module.
shapes_depth: Flat square-cornered boxes with thin outlines and pale tints: blue for the motion transformer and agent queries, pink for the map transformer and map queries, green for the planning transformer and constraints. Queries are rows of three small tinted squares; the ego query is a vertical stack of three squares (blue, green, pink) on a grey rounded tile. The BEV encoder is a white trapezoid, BEV features a 2x2 beige grid. Scene outputs appear as small illustrations on grey rounded tiles (cars with curved trajectory arrows; crossing lane arrows at an intersection), plus icons (steering wheel, pedal) for ego status, the driving command as bold italic quoted text, and a top-down road sketch with a green turn arrow. Sans-serif labels; arrow labels 'k, v' and 'q'.
proposed_highlight: Query tints are matched to the transformer that consumes them; the training-only constraints are set apart in their own titled grey panel outside the main background panel.
lesson: Draw the scene outputs as small vector illustrations on grey rounded tiles placed on the arrows between modules (cars with curved trajectory arrows, lane arrows crossing an intersection), so the vectorized representation is seen rather than named.
notes: Venue ICCV from Semantic Scholar (title match; venue_source: semantic-scholar); year 2023 = S2 year and arXiv year.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: one light-grey ground divided by a bottom ruler into four phases (Backbone, Vectorized Scene Learning, Planning Inferring Phase, Planning Training Phase), the motion and map transformers mirrored above and below the BEV features and the training-only constraints in a tall grey panel at the right

relations.form: multi-view images -> BEV encoder trapezoid -> BEV feature grid -> vectorized transformers -> ego query -> Planning Transformer -> ego vector, left to right
agent query -> Vectorized Motion Transformer runs along the top and map query -> Vectorized Map Transformer along the bottom, symmetric about the BEV features
a grey stack of three tinted ego-query squares sends k,v / q / k,v arrows into the Planning Transformer, with Ego Status from above and the 'Turn Left' driving command from below
motion vectors, map vectors and the planned ego trajectory are drawn as small top-down vector illustrations on grey rounded tiles on the arrows
motion, ego and map vectors run as long arrows into the right panel's three green constraint boxes (ego-agent collision, ego-boundary, ego-lane)

channels.colour: blue tint = agent/motion side, pink tint = map side, green = planning (Planning Transformer, constraint boxes, ego query), beige = BEV features; each query square takes the tint of the transformer that consumes it
channels.shape: trapezoid = encoder, rounded rectangles = transformers, small squares = queries, grey tiles = rendered vector outputs
channels.line: single solid black arrows for all flow; k, v and q labels on the arrows into the planner
channels.frame: a darker grey rounded panel sets apart the training-only constraints; a grey pill groups the ego query

quality.strengths: The motion/map symmetry about the BEV features shows two parallel scene streams by position; vectorized outputs are drawn as small scene illustrations rather than named; the phase ruler separates inference from training-only parts; query tints match their consumers.
quality.weaknesses: Updated agent/map query arrows cross between rows with L-bends; the long motion and map vector arrows run across the whole planning area to reach the constraint panel; the constraints are text boxes only, with their meaning left to Figure 3.

insights.structure: Everything sits on one large light-grey rounded ground divided by a bottom ruler into four phases (Backbone, Vectorized Scene Learning, Planning Inferring Phase, Planning Training Phase); motion and map transformers mirror each other above and below the BEV features, and a tall grey right-hand panel stacks the three green planning-constraint boxes.
insights.data: Inputs are a stack of real street-view photos; agent, map and ego queries are rows of three pastel squares; outputs are drawn as small rounded icon tiles (car motion trails, a crossing map-vector glyph, a steering-wheel ego status, a quoted 'Turn Left' command).
insights.emphasis: Module fills colour-code their query type (blue motion, pink map, green planning), and the training-only constraints are set apart in their own titled panel at the right edge.
insights.flow: Left to right: images -> trapezoid BEV Encoder -> BEV grid, which splits up and down to the two vectorized transformers; their updated queries converge into a central ego-query column feeding the Planning Transformer, and the motion/ego/map vectors run as long horizontal arrows into the constraint panel.
insights.avoid: The phase ruler under the figure does not line up with obvious frames above it, and the Updated Map/Agent Query cross-feeds add short loops that are easy to misread.

arrangement.units: one shared grey ground with phases marked by a bottom ruler; the last phase (training constraints) is its own titled grey panel on the right
arrangement.inputs_as: stacked real multi-view street images, plus agent and map query squares at the left edge
arrangement.losses_at: right edge, as a titled panel of three constraint boxes
arrangement.shared: BEV features drawn once in the centre feeding both transformers
